name: Writesonic
shortDescription: Content and brand-tracking plans. Starter is $79 per month billed annually.
longDescription: Writesonic's pricing page lists a Starter plan at $79 per month when billed annually, and says it tracks a brand across chat products and Google AI Overviews.
pricingNotes: Starter is listed at $79 per month when billed annually. This listing leaves startingPrice empty so the UI does not drop the annual-billing condition.
bestFor: Drafting content on a plan that also tracks brand mentions
notIdealFor: Someone who wants a published month-to-month price
strength: Writesonic lists a Starter plan at $79 per month when that plan is billed annually.
weakness: The figure is the annual-billing price, not a month-to-month rate.
